how.title: How it works
how.1.b: In English, Arabic, Turkish or Urdu. Questions about rulings go to a scholar, never to the model.
how.2.b: Hybrid search over the Qur'an and graded hadith from HadeethEnc, in your language.
how.3.b: Two to four short sentences, each tied to the passages it comes from; unsupported sentences are dropped.
how.4.b: The answer becomes a sequence of signs, using only signs that exist in that sign language's lexicon.
how.5.b: Recorded sign poses are stitched together and drive a 3D avatar or a keypoint skeleton.

lex.note: Coverage counts how many content words in the Qur'an and hadith have a recorded sign. Words without one are shown in red and held in the video.

pipeline.title: 3D Kinematic Inference & Generative Architecture
pipeline.lead: From spoken audio to 50-joint kinematic matrix and 3D avatar rendering
pipeline.step.1.title: Spoken Speech & Vocalized Text (Speech & Text)
pipeline.step.1.desc: Real-time voice capture via high-accuracy ASR or vocalized Arabic text with morphological tokenization and phoneme timing alignment.
pipeline.step.2.title: Linguistic Embeddings & Rotary Position Encoding (RoPE Attention)
pipeline.step.2.desc: Aligns morphological roots and semantic context in a continuous vector space bridging Arabic grammar with expressive signing.
pipeline.step.2.meta: Rotary Positional Embedding · 512-dim · Multi-head Attention Matrix · Lexicon of 3,979 Signs
pipeline.step.3.title: 50-Joint Kinematic Trajectory (25 FPS Trajectory)
pipeline.step.3.desc: Dynamic skeletal coordinates generation preserving finger articulation accuracy and spatial boundary while preventing joint deformation.
pipeline.step.3.meta: 25 FPS · 50 3D Skeletal Constellations (8 Torso + 42 Hands) · Inverse Kinematics Alignment
pipeline.step.4.title: Real-time Kinematic Rendering via Interactive Avatar (3D Avatar Engine)
pipeline.step.4.desc: Real-time sign language simulation on 3D virtual avatars dressed in authentic Saudi and Islamic cultural garments.
pipeline.step.4.meta: Blender & Three.js Pipeline · VRM 1.0 Rigging · Thobe, Ghutra & Hijab · Studio Lighting Tracking
